# MyHosh Salisbury (Myhosh Turkish Restaurant)

> Authentic Turkish and Mediterranean charcoal grill restaurant located at 99 Fisherton Street, Salisbury, Wiltshire SP2 7SP, United Kingdom.

## Core Details
- Address: 99 Fisherton Street, Salisbury, Wiltshire, SP2 7SP, UK
- Phone: +44 7853 404534
- Website & Online Reservations: https://myhosh-salisbury.co.uk/#reserve
- Cuisine: Turkish, Mediterranean, Charcoal Grill, Cold & Hot Meze
- Price Range: ££ (GBP)

## Opening Hours
- Monday: 16:00 to 22:30
- Tuesday: Closed
- Wednesday: 16:00 to 22:30
- Thursday: 16:00 to 22:30
- Friday: 16:00 to 22:30
- Saturday: 12:00 to 22:30
- Sunday: 12:00 to 22:00

## Signature Menu Highlights
- Cold Meze Platter (£16.95): Humus, Cacik, Kisir, Stuffed Vine Leaves, Beetroot Yoghurt, Aubergine Napolitana
- Hot Meze Platter (£17.95): Borek, Calamari, Whitebait, Halloumi Cheese, Falafel, Sucuk
- Grill Sharing Platter for 3 to 4 People (£79.95): Charcoal grill meats, meze, rice, bulgur, salad, and chips
- Dietary Options: Vegetarian (V), Vegan (VG), and Gluten Free (GF) options available; guests should inform staff of allergies.

## Reservation Policy
- Online table bookings available for parties up to 20 guests; larger groups and events should call +44 7853 404534 directly.
- Standard sitting duration is 2 hours with a 15-minute grace hold period.
